item.title: Nissan aids quake-hit Mindanao communities
item.description: Nissan Philippines and its employees have extended financial support to communities affected by the earthquake that struck parts of Mindanao in June.

item.title: Green SM earns two HR Asia awards
item.description: Green SM received two awards at the HR Asia Awards 2026 in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, after it was named among the Best Companies to Work for in Asia and won the Technology Empowerment Award.

item.title: Volvo honors seat belt pioneer
item.description: Volvo Cars Philippines marked the birth anniversary of Swedish engineer Nils Bohlin, whose three-point seat belt changed automotive safety and became standard equipment in vehicles around the world.

item.title: Toyota gives buyers more choices, greater savings
item.description: Toyota Motor Philippines is offering cash discounts and added ownership benefits across several models under its July Drive Deals campaign, which runs until 31 July 2026.

item.title: Small car, wide appeal
item.description: The VinFast VF 3 has started to find its place among Filipino motorists who want a small electric car that can handle daily travel without taking up too much road space or adding heavily to monthly expenses.

item.title: This Tiny Hatchback Is The Best-Selling Car In China. But How?
item.description: China's hottest EV isn't an SUV—it's an affordable hatchback that's outselling the Tesla Model Y.

item.title: Kimi Antonelli Wins Belgian Grand Prix and Extends Points Lead Following Teammate's Lap 1 Retirement
item.description: Kimi Antonelli gained his first GP victory since his DNF in Spain last month and doubled his points lead over his teammate, George Russell, who was hit by his former teammate Lewis Hamilton on lap one to add insult to injury.
